entry.title: AEW Fright Night Dynamite results, October 28, 2026: Aminata wins the TBS title
entry.summary: Queen Aminata beat Persephone for the TBS Championship, Darby Allin kept the TNT Championship against Josh Alexander, and the Motor City Machine Guns took Match 3 from FTR.

entry.title: AEW books Ospreay vs. Fletcher for Full Gear and a Collision card
entry.summary: Tony Khan made Will Ospreay versus Kyle Fletcher official for the AEW World Championship at Full Gear. Saturday's Collision has a posted card, and a women's Blood and Guts match is set.

entry.title: How a WWE Last Man Standing match ends
entry.summary: WWE's Last Man Standing match has no pinfall, no submission, and no disqualification. It ends when a wrestler cannot get up before a count of 10, and a draw leaves a title with the champion.

entry.title: AEW Fright Night Dynamite preview: Allin vs. Alexander and two more title stakes
entry.summary: Darby Allin defends the TNT title against Josh Alexander, Persephone faces Queen Aminata for the TBS title, and FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns wrestle Match 3 tonight in St. Louis.

entry.title: NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 card and how to watch on October 31
entry.summary: Grayson Waller defends the NXT Championship against Tony D'Angelo and Kelani Jordan faces Wren Sinclair at Halloween Havoc, live on The CW on Saturday, October 31.

entry.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 match card: four matches set for November 7 in Riyadh
entry.summary: Roman Reigns vs. Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan vs. Chelsea Green headline Crown Jewel on November 7, but both SmackDown champions must first survive title defenses on October 30.

entry.title: WWE NXT results, October 27, 2026: Dusty Cup finals set, Drake retains
entry.summary: Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno upset The Vanity Project and will meet Hank and Tank in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic final, while Jackson Drake kept the North American title.

entry.title: WWE Raw holds at 2.5 million Netflix views for October 19 episode
entry.summary: Netflix's weekly Top 10 lists the October 19 Raw at 2.5 million views and 4.3 million hours viewed, ninth on its global shows chart.

entry.title: Penta and Je'Von Evans get a World Tag Team title match at Crown Jewel
entry.summary: WWE made Penta and Je'Von Evans vs. Bron Breakker and Austin Theory for the World Tag Team Championship at Crown Jewel on November 7.

entry.title: WWE Raw results, October 26, 2026: Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan keep their titles
entry.summary: Sami Zayn beat Je'Von Evans to keep the Undisputed WWE Championship, and Liv Morgan kept the Women's World Championship when Becky Lynch won by disqualification.

entry.title: AEW Collision results, October 24, 2026: FTR tie the series, women's Blood and Guts made
entry.summary: FTR beat the Motor City Machine Guns to tie their Best of 5 series, Jay White beat Kyle O'Reilly, and AEW confirmed a women's Blood and Guts match for November 4.

entry.title: AEW Dynamite results, October 21, 2026: Dragunov wins debut, men's Blood and Guts set
entry.summary: Ilja Dragunov beat Mike Bailey in his AEW debut, Queen Aminata earned a TBS title shot, and the Don Callis Family accepted a men's Blood and Guts match for November 4.
